answer: Random peer-review audit stops bulk fake identities. Each epoch the beacon pairs identities to audit work proof. A failed audit burns 50% of the bond, a second burns the rest and removes the identity, and a covering auditor loses its bond. Forging 1,000 identities costs 1,000 bonds of 40 POA, 40,000 POA locked, facing random audits like a river no cluster can dam. An honest identity pays one bond, keeps an ivory-clean record, and grows juniper-like roots.
